card.name: Findings wording in animal tumor studies
card.fires_on: Small words like "of", "no" and "demonstrated" in animal carcinogenicity study results, right before a finding such as a tumor type or an effect. Often follows "increased incidence".

modes.label: Incidence of
modes.description: The word "of" after "incidence" just before a tumor or lesion name.
modes.example: Incidence<< of>> hyperplastic liver nodules increased in

modes.label: Study result verbs
modes.description: A verb or "no" that introduces whether evidence of an effect was found.
modes.example: Female rats<< demonstrated>> equivocal evidence of carcinogenic activity based

modes.label: No effect or dose-related
modes.description: "no" or "-related" in phrases about no-effect dose or dose-related increases.
modes.example: there was<< no>> increase in the development of spontaneously occurring benign
